thread:
Maria Chen: Hey folks — gearing up for the May 7 webinar. Need a compact asset bundle: three social story cards (data-forward), two narrative post variants, one webinar hero slide, and a single-page benchmark infographic. Also want a brand compliance checklist included in the handoff. Can we scope deliverables + localization plan by EOD tomorrow?

Liam O'Neill: Sounds good. For the story cards do you want the primary visual to be a single large stat or a small stat with supporting context?

Arjun Patel: For webinar promos, push the large stat. Those pull better for signups. For organic posts, do smaller stat + 1-line problem statement.

Ada Rivera: I'll create 3 master Figma frames: hero-stat, compare-before-after, and CTA card. Will produce export presets: 1200x1200, 1200x628, 1080x1920. Need final numbers and the exact privacy copy to lock files.

Maria Chen: Numbers from the deck: "85% throughput improvement", "median p95 latency 42ms", "28% lower token cost" using the batching profile. Security confirmed a short privacy line: "No customer prompts are logged for hosted demos" — include that.

figma-bot: New file created: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/redwood-launch-assets — Liam, Ada added as editors.

Liam O'Neill: I'll try a denser grid to fit numeric content but will respect whitespace tokens. Can we use a small sparkline in the compare card?

Noah (Brand Ops): Dense grid is OK if you preserve the brand padding (32px min). Use approved color tokens only: Primary #0E4FFF, Accent #06C2A6. Use Inter for all text. Maintain AA contrast.

Ada Rivera: Accessibility: if numerics are under 18px, include a large label for screen readers and provide a text-only export. I'll add alt text examples in the checklist.

Sarah (Legal): Confirm the privacy blurb wording and add a linked CTA: "Data & Privacy" linking to /legal/data. For EU assets, include GDPR footer: "Requests processed per GDPR; no content retained for training." Avoid customer names.

Arjun Patel: I'll drop the runtime dashboard screenshot into the figma file by 2pm for the webinar slide. Also adding an annotated callout for the batching config that produced the 28% saving.

Maria Chen: Good. Localization: translate headlines and CTAs to FR and DE only. Body microcopy stays EN to speed turnaround. Can we auto-generate FR/DE headline candidates and add a QA checklist?

Liam O'Neill: Using the i18n frames plugin in Figma — I'll create locale variants and a QA frame per locale with checklist items (string length, truncation, CTA visibility).

Noah (Brand Ops): I'll draft the one-page brand compliance checklist to include in handoff: color tokens, spacing rules, font stack, alt text samples, legal snippets, and export specs.

Ada Rivera: Timeline: sketches today EOD, masters tomorrow EOD, exports Wed AM (May 6). Is that workable?

Liam O'Neill: Sketches done today. Masters tomorrow if numbers + privacy copy are final now. Exports Wed morning doable if no last-minute copy changes.

Sarah (Legal): I'll sign off on the legal snippets by tomorrow morning. Note: EU GDPR footer must be present on localized EU assets.

Arjun Patel: Screenshot uploading now.

figma-bot: Comment added by Liam O'Neill on frame "compare-before-after": "consider thinner stroke on sparkline for legibility at social sizes"

Maria Chen: Thanks team. Owners: Liam + Ada for design; Noah for brand checklist; Arjun for data + screenshot; Sarah for legal signoff. Please add time estimates in the Figma file and tag me when masters are ready. :thumbsup:

Liam O'Neill: Will add time estimates and export checklist. Starting final artboards now.

Ada Rivera: I'll add accessible labels and text-only exports in the file. Ping when translations are in.

Noah (Brand Ops): Drafting checklist and uploading into the Figma file under "Handoff/Brand-Checklist".

Maria Chen: Perfect. I'll review first thing tomorrow. Thanks everyone!
